[[File:CanalDistrict-VQ.jpg|thumb|right|upright|The bar was located in the Canal District of Dubrava.]]
A '''bar''' was located in the [[Canal District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]]. The [[Cantina|bar]] sat on an island in the swamp, connected to nearby islands by a system of waterways and a pier-like bridge system. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jal Te Gniev]] acted as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] recruiter from the establishment. At this same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Unidentified Snivvian bartender (Dubrava)|bartender]] was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]]. Due to Gniev's drunkenness, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the name of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as the pilot who had destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Gniev's blunder also brought a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to the bar, where they burned it to the ground with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]].
